cards.title: Retire Kalshi copy-routing (venue gate is structurally unsatisfiable) — implement at Phase C kickoff

cards.gate: Kelly measurement window (Sep 8–Oct 8): nothing ships before the Oct 8 read (precommit-mid-oct-kelly-gate). Also wait for the Sep 15 λ̂ refit if the venueOffsetKalshi input is touched.
cards.note: REVIEW 2026-09-13 (drafts/kalshi-venue-dormancy-review-20260913.md, option A approved in-thread): the Kalshi leg has taken 0 trades since 2026-08-30 23:44 and 0 of 335 C-200 copies since the breaker cleared (Sep 5 08:39). Root cause is structural, not an outage: the venue gate (scripts/score-trades.ts:579-586) tests TWO stages of the same score — confidence = (pre-boost composite − 35)/65, so confidence > 0.8 requires a pre-boost composite ≥ 87.33, while copyScore ≥ 80 is read POST-boost and any sentiment-boosted score is clamped to 79 by regulatoryScoreCap (v34) — i.e. the two legs are mutually exclusive; the single qualifying candidate (Sep 12 23:52, conf 0.82) was blocked by the 79 < 80 clamp. v37 (activated 2026-08-31 04:58) is the semantic switch that killed the flow (pre-v37 confidence came from the post-boost score; 92 Kalshi trades landed in the 20 days before it). Compounding: 296/335 C-200 copies since Sep 5 are short-TTR lane copies whose confidence is hard-coded 0 (routing stays Polymarket). DECISION (option A): retire the copy-routing branch; Kalshi remains in the stack ONLY for Phase C cross-venue arb (phase-c) and the TR-16 adapter stays. Do NOT 'fix' this by restoring the pre-v37 semantics — that would route the 20 post-Sep-5 copies with copyScore ≥ 87.5, which are −$578.64 realized on Polymarket. SIDE FINDING (fold into the same change): premium-calibration venueOffsetKalshi (+0.328, refit 2026-09-01) was fitted on the phantom-priced Kalshi rows (all 73 closed rows bookedEntry = 0.50 exactly) and is added to λ̂ when sizing a Kalshi-routed copy (score-trades.ts:602, 682) — a bigger λ̂ means smaller size. Zero live impact while routing is dormant; recompute/retire the input as part of this card. Verify after implementation: `grep -c 'executionVenue = "Kalshi"' scripts/score-trades.ts` → 0, and `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PaperTrade WHERE venue='Kalshi' AND openedAt > <impl-date>` → 0 (no new Kalshi-labelled rows).

cards.title: Kalshi shadow ledger + shadow expectancy score (measurement lane, live in the dashboard)
cards.effort: shipped 2026-09-13 (~half day): scripts/shadow-expectancy-model.py --fit, scripts/kalshi-shadow.py, src/components/kalshi-shadow.tsx, cron copybot-kalshi-shadow (15m) + copybot-kalshi-shadow-report (daily 18:30)
cards.dates: Shipped 2026-09-13 · OOS clock started 2026-09-13 · switchover decision at the Oct 8 Kelly read
cards.gate: Kelly window frozen through 2026-10-08: this lane is OBSERVABILITY ONLY (no effect on admission, sizing, routing or venue). Any live switchover is a post-Oct-8 decision needing explicit approval.
cards.note: WHY: the venue gate is structurally unsatisfiable and the live score is inverted — measured 2026-09-13 on 9,734 finished copies: winners have LOWER copyScore (75.0 vs 77.6, t=-12.8), lower walletQuality (-16.3), lower categoryFit (-19.8), lower thesis (-18.6); in the C-200 lane the top score bin (82+) wins 35% for -$1.79/trade while the bottom bin (35.5-62.7) wins 56% for +$1.81/trade. The score optimises WIN RATE in a favourite-longshot market, where win rate and expectancy decouple (0.82-1.0 band: 87% win, -4.9% ROI). WHAT SHIPPED: (1) a shadow expectancy model trained on realized PnL per dollar staked with decision-time features only (WalletProfile columns excluded — not point-in-time) and PURGED walk-forward (a training row is eligible only once its outcome settled); purged OOS rank IC +0.093 on C-200, and in the purged main-lane slice the top-30% policy returns +$227 (+25.6% ROI) vs -$238 (-10.4%) for the incumbent copyScore / +$50 for the raw composite, on 578 OOS rows. (2) an idempotent Kalshi shadow ledger (data/kalshi-shadow.jsonl + data/kalshi-shadow-summary.json) attributing the all-Polymarket C-200 book across four candidate venue rules — gate as written (n=105, +$89, +9.5%), pre-v37 semantics (n=133, -$599, -31.6%), repaired raw bar (n=36, +$83, +26.8%), shadow model (n=795, +$990, +21.3%). (3) dashboard cards next to the live PnL tiles (Live PM / Kalshi shadow slice / PM-only remainder + a three-line cumulative path) and a model card. (4) a daily Discord report (copybot-kalshi-shadow-report) with recommendations. HONESTY RULE: the shadow-model split is IN-SAMPLE (fitted on the rows it scores). The only forward evidence is the OOS clock (shadowScoreSplit.oosSinceFit) which starts at 0 and fills as new copies settle — do not quote the +21.3% as a forward result. NEXT (post-Oct-8): if the OOS clock holds positive with n>=100, wire the score as the admission/sizing input and switch the venue rule to the repaired single-variable bar; if it does not, retire the model and keep the ledger as an attribution view. Verify: `python3 scripts/kalshi-shadow.py --quiet && python3 -c "import json;s=json.load(open('data/kalshi-shadow-summary.json'));print(s['shadowScoreSplit']['oosSinceFit'])"` — OOS n grows and PnL sign tracks the model's claim.

PMA validation, LOW risk, shadow-lane first, flag-revertible); (2) fold the mcp-server confirmation-gate + SELL-reduces-by-min(order,pos)/no-position-SELL-adds-exposure semantics (MIT, concept-only, ~2–4h doc work) into the sidecar risk-gate spec. NOTHING ships before the Kelly window closes Oct 8 (precommit-mid-oct-kelly-gate). AUDIT INPUT (2026-09-08, user-queued post-Kelly; drafts/ccxt-audit.md): multi-venue quote data backbone = **ccxt** (MIT; Polymarket+Kalshi+Hyperliquid coverage verified 2026-09-08) — adopt for arb quote breadth + perp-funding/OHLCV feature lane; do NOT churn existing bespoke CLOB/data-api/Kalshi read lanes. AUDIT INPUT (2026-09-09, user-approved carding; drafts/poly-maker-audit.md): warproxxx/poly-maker (MIT, Python, 1.5k★, 111/111 tests) is a maker-only MM bot whose core is the INTRA-VENUE half of this card — a YES+NO pair merged back to collateral locks edge 1−p−q. Two borrows for the design window (Sep 15–30): (1) the CTF pair-merge primitive — mergePositions across EOA / Gnosis Safe / V2 DepositWallet via the gasless builder relayer, nonce-serialized, LIVE-VERIFIED on-chain (tx 0x4d2a2064) — gives zero-market-impact exits AND makes the Polymarket-only YES+NO≠1 leg buildable WITHOUT any Kalshi dependency, sidestepping the phase-kalshi1 keyless data wall (our sidecar already reads top-of-book keyless); (2) reward-band quoting (half-spread clamped into rewardsMaxSpread, per-ORDER min qualifying size, both legs bid so both sides score) as the maker counterfactual to our taker entries — see drafts/c200-taker-fee-measurement-2026-09-09.md (fee = C×rate×p(1−p); politics 0.04; maker rebate 25%). Port cost: read ≈½ day, dry-run port ≈ 2–3 days (cost is wallet-type signing + builder-relayer creds, not logic); ship as a manual CLI primitive first, flag-revertible. CAVEAT: the repo's own live session LOST $15.51 — the maker-lane strategy is an unproven hypothesis; the merge primitive is the part worth taking.

cards.title: 2027 homelab funding schedule → production forecast inputs
cards.note: Homelab hardware purchases unlock ONLY after production CopyBot proves ≥$500/day (7 consecutive days, C-200 advance rule). HARD DEADLINE: TrueNAS R740xd + 12× recert drives (~$3–4.5k) must be purchased by end of Q3 2027 (2027-09-30) — the program's only dated gate. Derived: production proof should land ≈ Q2 2027 to keep sourcing/ordering float. C-200 tuning should size intermediate targets so the cascade holds: Dec 1 2026 ladder → early-2027 production rollout → Q2 2027 proof. Track A (Mac Studio M5 Ultra 256GB ~$9.5k + RTX PRO 5000 48GB ~$5.2–6.5k + Odin RAM) is post-proof with no hard date. Full detail: ~/homelab/roadmap.md sequencing gate + Track B #4. CAPITAL STRUCTURE (decided 2026-09-08, production Jan 2 2027, $500/day assumed): sweep 50% of NET daily profit (max(0, net); governor pauses sweep if trailing-30d capital < floor; compute daily via query_bankroll, transfer weekly). Inside the swept 50%: ~30% to TAX RESERVE first (HYSA/MMF; quarterly estimates; user chose reserve-in-sweep for safety, 2026-09-08) → then Sep-2027 gate bucket (T-bill ladder ≤9mo maturing ≈ 2027-09-30) → personal floor (3–6mo expenses) → then VTI/VXUS growth (NOT PM/crypto — diversify away from the edge). cards.effort: ~30 min (move copies++/laneCopies++ and the lane log inside the leg loop; or count actual opened positions)
cards.note: SHIPPED 2026-09-13. scripts/score-trades.ts: copies++/laneCopies++, the '[SHORT-TTR lane] BANKROLL_200 copy: ...' log and the Discord 'New paper copy' alert were emitted per scored DECISION, outside the per-leg `for` loop. Moved all three inside the loop, immediately after a successful openPaperTrade (verified by brace-depth analysis: copies++ now sits at the same depth as the open call, brace balance 0). Effects: (1) 'Scoring complete: N paper copies' now counts copies that passed every gate — lifetime it read 5,120 against 1,879 real execution intents; (2) capRisk (lane 10/cycle, main 50/cycle) is now consumed only by real copies, so a busy cycle can reach its designed budget instead of being throttled by blocked candidates (no cap has ever been hit, so no behaviour change expected in practice); (3) the Discord alert no longer fires for phantom copies — quantified from the DB: 4,021 of 14,435 copy decisions (28%) all-time, 227 of 274 in the 24h to 2026-09-13 have no PaperTrade row, i.e. most of the 'New paper copy' pings were for positions that never existed. Semantics note: for BANKROLL_200 this counts dispatched intents (the Rust sidecar writes the row via webhook); for STANDARD it counts rows written. 147 tests + tsc clean.

cards.gate: VERIFIED: state file has basis+peakRule+basisDeclaredAt; newest [DRAWDOWN-SHADOW] line starts 'basis=mtm'; Y in the [RISK-GATE] gross-exposure line = 1000 + 0.5*(NW_mtm-1900) ±$1.
cards.note: data/c200-drawdown.json now carries basis (mtm|realized|min), peakRule, basisDeclaredAt, note. score-trades derives the peak ratchet, the equity-linked exposure cap and the drawdown gate from that single value; [DRAWDOWN-SHADOW] leads with basis=<x>, [RISK-GATE] names the basis. Legacy files without basis keep MTM. DECLARED: basis=mtm = today's behaviour made explicit. OPEN for the user: switching to realized/min is one field but the same $1,300 book is 88.0% of cap ($1,477.97) on MTM vs 130.0% ($1,000) on realized-only — i.e. ~$300 of forced deleverage mid-window. Deliberately not taken unilaterally.
